page_title: GRA 2-0 CAD | Granada CF v Cadiz CF 03/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Fali (Cadiz) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+7' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Granada CF comes to nothing.

90+4' Nice individual effort by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the left side of the goal, but Conan Ledesma does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Granada CF.
90+2' A corner kick by Cadiz CF is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Granada CF).
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
88' Alexandre Medina has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) replacing Alvaro Fernandez.
87' Granada CF fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
86' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Granada CF.
83' Cadiz CF fail to score from a corner as Augusto Batalla (Granada CF) leaps to collect the ball.
80' Substitution. Alvaro Negredo (Cadiz) in, Chris Ramos out.
80' The substitution is prepared. Jesus Vallejo (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ricard Sanchez.
80' Alexandre Medina decides to make a substitution. Myrto Uzuni will be replaced by Matias Arezo (Granada CF).
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) for Bruno Mendez.
79' Flag up against Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
78' The referee signals a corner kick to Cadiz CF.
78' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
76' It will be a substitution. Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) is ready to enter the pitch as Ruben Alcaraz walks off.
72' Substitution. Lucas Boye will be replaced by Jose Callejon (Granada CF).

70' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) gets on the end of a brilliant pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net by striking the ball past the goalkeeper!
68' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but Augusto Batalla comes off his line to gather the ball.
65' Juan Pulido has issued a yellow card to Lucas Boye (Granada CF).
64' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
63' The attendance for today's match is 17732.
58' Today's match ends for Maximiliano Gomez who will be replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
58' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
54' He’s off! Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) gets his marching orders from referee Juan Pulido after the VAR review.

54' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz), but referee Juan Pulido must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
53' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
52' The referee blows his whistle as Chris Ramos (Cadiz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
50' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Pulido who sees an offensive foul. Cadiz CF will take a free kick.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Darwin Machis (Cadiz) comes off for Robert Navarro.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Sergio probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alex Fernandez (Cadiz). He is replaced by Rominigue Kouame.
46' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+11' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+11' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+11' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Cadiz CF will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+6' The Cadiz CF players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Juan Pulido. NO PENALTY!
45+5' Celebrations by Cadiz CF are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
45+4' Augusto Batalla (Granada CF) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Pulido signals. Cadiz CF are given a penalty!

45+3' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
43' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Chris Ramos (Cadiz) for his blatant foul.
42' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
38' A terrific attempt by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
36' Some neat passing and movement from Granada CF as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
34' The corner is swung in but Granada CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

33' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Granada CF win a corner kick.
29' Granada CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

28' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Conan Ledesma pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick.

22' 1 - 0 Referee Juan Pulido points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Granada CF players. Gooal! Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Lucas Boye. He makes it 1:0.
21' Wait! Referee Juan Pulido immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
21' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
21' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Granada CF.
18' The Lucas Boye (Granada CF) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Juan Pulido rules it out for a handball.
16' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) commits a foul and Juan Pulido immediately signals a free kick.
15' One of the players from Cadiz CF times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
13' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
11' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
11' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
8' The Cadiz CF players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
4' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the middle of the target, but Conan Ledesma keeps it out.

3' What a miss! Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
2' A corner kick by Cadiz CF is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Granada CF).
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Granada CF will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido will referee today's match.
